description: This file defines feature availability and limits for the Notesnook project, including functions to check feature access based on user subscription plans, and manages feature configurations and limits.

methods.name: createFeature
methods.description: Creates a feature object with specified availability and error handling.

methods.name: createLimit
methods.description: Creates a limit object for a feature, inferring value and allowed status.

methods.name: isFeatureAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is available for the current user plan.

methods.name: getFeatureLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the feature limit based on the user's subscription plan.

methods.name: areFeaturesAvailable
methods.description: Checks availability for multiple features at once.

methods.name: getUserPlan
methods.description: Fetches the current user's subscription plan.

methods.name: availableOn
methods.description: Determines which subscription plan a feature is available on based on limits.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves a feature object by its ID.

methods.name: planToAvailability
methods.description: Maps a subscription plan to its feature availability category.

methods.name: getFeaturesTable
methods.description: Returns a table of features with their limits across plans.

methods.name: getFeaturesUsage
methods.description: Returns usage statistics for all features.
